surprises: Adding a vertical is not confined to the vertical's own catalog: `apps/web/lingui.config.ts` excludes `src/pages/**`, so the two verticals.ts navigation messages landed in the shared common catalog and `extract` rewrote all seven common .po files the phase had declared out of scope.

The row-range summary hit its second consumer on the very first table of the new vertical, so a copy that read as page-local in the athletes table became a promotion obligation the moment actors shipped.

No browser validation was possible in this run, and the closest jsdom proxy (asserting the `--table-min-width` custom property) does not actually prove horizontal containment below the AppShell breakpoint.

proposed_rules.diff: + - **A phase that touches `verticals.ts`, navigation, or any string outside `src/pages/**` must declare `apps/web/src/locales/common/**` in its `files`.** `apps/web/lingui.config.ts` routes those messages to the common catalog, so `pnpm --filter web extract` necessarily rewrites all seven common `.po` files. Omitting the glob reports required wiring as scope creep.

+ - **Point `verification_cmd` at the test directory, not a single spec file.** A page's assertions routinely split across sibling specs (`ActorsPage.test.tsx` plus `ActorsPage.columns.test.tsx`); a file-scoped command silently skips most of the phase's own coverage on every retry.

+ - **When an acceptance criterion requires real-browser validation, the phase notes and the commit message must state the result or say plainly that it was unavailable.** jsdom can assert that a style token is set; it cannot assert horizontal containment, focus order, or scroll behavior. An unstated gap reads as a passed check.
